rationale: LOO apple-to-centroid cosines are in [0.8110, 0.9379]. Non-apple references (4 synthetic Tier-3 images) score ≤ 0.57. Threshold 0.70 separates them with ~0.11 headroom on each side. Used as Tier-1.5 tie-breaker in demo/routing.py:route_image() when best Tier-1 and best Tier-2 CLIP prompts are within tie_margin=0.03 cosine.
